parts.html: The K-16 standard model is an elegant neoclassical design in which a striking green color is combined with clean geometry and a functional use of space. Solid-color fronts, an L-shaped configuration, and well-thought-out hardware create a harmonious interior that unites classic aesthetics with modern standards of comfort.

The green color scheme gives the kitchen individuality and creates a calm, cozy atmosphere. This shade pairs beautifully with light walls, natural wood, stone textures, and decorative accents in warm neutral tones.

The neoclassical style preserves the elegance of a traditional interior while avoiding excessive decoration. This makes the K-16 model well suited to modern apartments, condos, and private homes where aesthetics, practicality, and visual cohesion matter.

The kitchen’s defining feature is its L-shaped configuration with a length of 4.6 linear meters. Placing the cabinets along two adjoining walls allows for an efficient arrangement of work surfaces, built-in appliances, and storage.
Without a kitchen island, there is room left for a dining area and comfortable movement. This layout is especially convenient for rooms where the available space needs to be used efficiently.
The upper and lower fronts are foil-wrapped. A single shade of green unites the furniture elements into a cohesive composition and emphasizes the understated character of the neoclassical interior.
The chipboard-based countertop completes the kitchen cabinetry and provides a work surface for everyday cooking. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.
For convenient storage, the kitchen features a cargo pull-out that makes efficient use of the cabinets’ interior space.
Muller soft-close hinges and Muller soft-close telescopic drawer slides make the furniture comfortable to use. These mechanisms ensure that doors and drawers close smoothly.
The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included; lift-up mechanisms are not.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-16 standard model can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room, taking into account the location of utility connections and built-in appliances, as well as the client’s storage preferences.
When developing a custom design, the cabinet dimensions and the configuration of work surfaces can be adjusted, and the shade of the fronts can be chosen to match the overall interior concept.
We offer comprehensive services covering kitchen furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
You can order the K-16 kitchen or get a personalized price quote from DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
